name: issueai
description: Hypothesis-driven issue and bug discovery for real codebases.

interface.shortDescription: Find real issues through contextual bug hypotheses
interface.longDescription: IssueAI powers Issue Hunt: understand the repository and intended behavior first, generate contextual issue hypotheses, validate them with evidence, and keep benchmark and eval surfaces separate from default end-user workflows.
defaultPrompt: Run Issue Hunt on this repository.
Find likely real issues in this project.
Model intended behavior and validate contextual issue hypotheses for this codebase.
